roles.title: Web Developer & Travel Operations Assistant
roles.summary: Combined website development, reservation administration, and customer email support for a travel agency in Tunis.
responsibilities: Designed and built the agency’s website to present its travel services and help customers explore its offers.
Recorded customer reservations in the agency’s system and kept booking information organized.
Responded to customer emails, answered travel enquiries, and followed up on reservation requests.

roles.title: Retail Manager & Cashier
roles.summary: Managed supermarket operations and checkout service at Franprix in Paris, combining customer support with product photography and digital product administration.
responsibilities: Managed day-to-day store operations, assisted customers, and handled checkout transactions through the point-of-sale system.
Photographed new products and prepared clean images with white backgrounds for their digital records.
Created new item records and entered products into the store and cashier systems so they were ready for sale.

internship.title: Fibre Optic Technician Intern
internship.summary: Gained hands-on experience in fibre-optic technical work during a three-month internship with Bouygues Telecom, building on training completed at Excelforma in Paris.
